0.original: The naturalist Marcette at Dunstan's Spire is in need of a research assistant.

1.original: Marcette is doing research for the <hex:021A020203>New Eorzean Geographic<hex:021A020103>, her compendium of knowledge in the making, and requires toadstool caps to complete the chapter on fungi.

2.original: You have successfully obtained the toadstool caps. Deliver them to Marcette.

3.original: Marcette is immensely pleased with herself at her most recent scientific discovery─so pleased that she has entirely forgotten the identity of the adventurer who made it possible...

25.original: Deliver the toadstool caps to Marcette.

48.original: You have the honor of addressing Marcette, realm-renowned naturalist and esteemed authoress of the <hex:021A020203>New Eorzean Geographic<hex:021A020103>, the single most comprehensive collection of knowledge our realm has ever seen─or ever <hex:021A020203>will<hex:021A020103> see.

49.original: You've not heard of the <hex:021A020203>Geographic<hex:021A020103>? Why, of course you haven't─it hasn't been published yet! And it never will be if my assistants keep dawdling around instead of doing their jobs! So hop to it!

50.original: Of <hex:021A020203>course<hex:021A020103> I'm talking to you! Do you see anyone else here? Now, for the seventy-thousandth time: five toadstool caps, and be quick with them!

52.original: Have you brought me my toadstool caps? Each moment you dally deprives the realm of my prodigious knowledge!

53.original: Yes, yes, hand it over, now. But of course! It is just as I theorized─the spore density of these toadstools is exponentially greater than that of samples taken from before the Calamity!

54.original: Clearly, they have evolved as such in order to adapt to an increasingly harsh environment. Muahahaha! And with this, another entry of the <hex:021A020203>New Eorzean Geographic<hex:021A020103> is complete! ...Ahem, who are you, again?
